translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Nauman gail
book.title: Nauman gail Nǝsa ahai pispisul gail lotogole

content: APol mai aParnapas len nab̃iltivile Ikonium
Len naut a Ikonium aPol mai aParnapas arovi lan naim nab̃onb̃onan seJu hum naṽide sǝlaru. Nasoruan sǝlaru igol isob̃ur lukad nadǝlomian, naJu gail mai alat a Kris.
Be naJu galevis lotohaihai, lugol alat lǝsavi Ju nǝlolit epǝŋas nǝvanuan nadǝlomian gail.

Imaienan aPol mai aParnapas arutoh ebǝlav ei. Arsamǝtahw, arusor m̃os Nasub̃. Ale Nasub̃ igol p̃arp̃ar hǝni ke, napisulan artokele husur navoian toviol kǝmas hǝni ekitin, bathut len nǝdaŋan san arolǝboi arb̃igol namerikel gail.
Alat lototoh len navile enan lopǝpehw. Galevis lohusur nǝnauan seJu gail, galevis lohusur nap̃usanan sihai pispisul eru enan.
Alat lǝsavi Ju, naJu gail mai alat lotoil a m̃o hǝn galito, lusor utaut hǝni ke, lemǝdas gǝlaru ale letubun gǝlaru.
Nǝboŋ artolǝboii ke b̃imaienan, arugam yav vi lan nab̃iltivile eru, a Listra mai a Terpe len naut a Likaonia.
Len nǝyaran sǝlaru pǝpadaŋ hǝn nab̃iltivile eru enan, arukelkel na-kel-uri-an tovoi mai nǝvanuan gail.
APol mai aParnapas len naut a Listra
Len naut a Listra ikad avan sua tobǝtah, narien gǝlar p̃isi arugau. Nǝboŋ lotopasi, imaienan tia. Gai sǝyar boŋ ideh.
Atenan esǝsǝloŋ hǝn aPol nǝboŋ tosor. APol ekǝta van hǝni ale eris lǝboii ke tokad nadǝlomian hǝn b̃imaur.
APol ikai habat van hǝni ke, “Gile mǝhat len nariem̃! Geil!” Ale aten emǝlah vi mǝhat, etub̃at yar.
Nǝboŋ naluṽoh lotoris nǝsa aPol togole, lukai len nasoruan ta Likaonia ke, “Nagot gail logǝm vi pan hǝn gidato, logǝm vi vanuan.”
Lokis aParnapas hǝn aSeus mai aPol hǝn aHermes husur aPol tokel ur nasoruan.

Ikad naim nalotuan siSeus vivile hǝn nab̃iltivile. Ahai tutumav siSeus esǝhar nab̃uluk ulum̃an gail lotowan nahorasal van hǝn nametlǝkau hǝn nab̃iltivile, husur gai mai naluṽoh luke letutumav van hǝn gǝlaru.
Avil nǝboŋ ahai pispisul eru, aParnapas mai aPol artosǝsǝloŋ hǝn natenan, arutar nahurabat sǝlaru, arom̃ur van hǝn naluṽoh, arukai ke,

“Lalum̃an, imabe mǝtugol nategai? Namrovi vanuan ŋai sum̃an gamito. Namrogǝm hǝn namrb̃ikel na-kel-uri-an tovoi mai gamit hǝn mǝtb̃ipair dan natgaleg lotodǝdas lǝb̃evi tarhǝt samito, van hǝn aGot tovi nǝkadun nǝmauran. Gai igol nǝmav mai nǝtan mai nǝtas mai natit p̃isi lotosuh len gail.
Sutuai tia idam̃ hǝni ke naluṽoh hǝn nǝvanuan tiltile gail lotohusur nap̃isal salit ṽisusua.

Naut kǝmas natenan, igol nǝvanuan p̃isi lolǝboi lǝb̃eris lǝboi gai len navoian togole. Eviol hǝn naus togǝm len nǝmav, eviol hǝn nǝhanian toṽan len nǝboŋ han; igol ke mǝttopul hǝn nǝhanian mai nǝlomit topul hǝn nakemkeman.”
Be naut kǝmas artokǝmaienan, arusab̃i ke idaŋ hǝn arb̃igol ke lǝb̃esib hǝn natutumavan salito.

Beti len nǝboŋ tile naJu galevis logǝm len naut a Antiok mai a Ikonium, ale lupair hǝn nǝnauan sinaluṽoh van hǝn galito. Lotuṽ aPol ke timat ale loliv gargari vivile len nab̃iltivile husur lunau ke tomat.
Be nǝboŋ ahai susur gail lotob̃on il garu hǝn aPol, ile mǝhat, iyar tǝlmam van hǝn nab̃iltivile. Pelan han aPol mai aParnapas aroriŋ naut a Listra, arovi Terpe.
APol mai aParnapas arotǝlmam vi Antiok a Siria
Arukel na-kel-uri-an tovoi len naut a Terpe ale lusob̃ur logǝm vi hai susur siYesu gail. Beti arotǝlmam vi Listra, Ikonium mai Antiok.
Arugol ahai susur gail ludaŋ am, arugol lolǝŋon ivoi am len nǝlolito hǝn lǝb̃eil gǝgat len nadǝlomian. Aruke, “Datimasdaŋ b̃ur na-lǝŋon-isa-an tosob̃ur hǝn datb̃eb̃is len natohan pipihabǝlan aGot.”
APol mai aParnapas arutabtabuh len ahaṽut galevis hǝn lǝb̃eil a m̃o hǝn alat siYesu len naut ṽisusua. Arusor tuṽ, arsǝhan, ale aroriŋ galit len navǝlan Nasub̃, gai lotoriŋ nǝlolit lan.
Nǝboŋ artoyar tur len naut gail a Pisitia, arubar naut a Pamfilia.
Ale len naut enan, nǝboŋ artokel ur nasoruan len nab̃iltivile Perka tonoŋ, arovi pan vi Attalia bitas.
Aroriŋ nab̃iltivile Attalia, aruwol tǝlmam vi Antiok. Evi alat siYesu len naut a Antiok lotoriŋ gǝlaru len navǝlan aGot m̃os nauman artomadhaum vurvuri.

Nǝboŋ artobar naut a Antiok, arous alat siYesu ei hǝn lǝb̃ib̃onb̃on, ale arukel ur mai galit natit p̃isi aGot togole len nab̃onan sǝlaru maii. Arukel husur nap̃isal aGot togole hǝn b̃esǝŋav hǝn nabopita hǝn nadǝlomian m̃os alat lǝsavi Ju.
Beti arutoh mai ahai susur gail ei ebǝlav.

footnotes.text: 14.12 ASeus eil a m̃o hǝn nagot p̃isi silat a Kris, aHermes evi nagot sua tovi ahai pispisul sinagot salit gail.
